# Made From Effort

> Made From Effort designs and builds bespoke home, estate, and yacht gyms, and provides private performance training. Based on Long Island, NY, working worldwide. Run by Scott Schratwieser.

Made From Effort's Journal covers gym design, training consistency, and the systems that make both hold up — written from real projects, not generic fitness content.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.madefromeffort.com/): Overview of gym design and training services, portfolio, and contact.
- [Training](https://www.madefromeffort.com/training.html): Private personal training programs.
- [Start a Project](https://www.madefromeffort.com/contact.html): Contact and project inquiry form.
- [Investment Estimator](https://www.madefromeffort.com/estimator.html): Directional cost estimator for a custom gym build.

## Portfolio

- [Private Yacht Gym](https://www.madefromeffort.com/project-yacht.html): Custom marine gym installation aboard a private yacht.
- [Jericho Private Estate](https://www.madefromeffort.com/project-jericho.html): Home gym and cedar sauna built into a Long Island, NY estate.
- [Jupiter Island Estate](https://www.madefromeffort.com/project-jupiter-island.html): Custom home gym inside a Jupiter Island, FL estate.

## Journal

- [Journal index](https://www.madefromeffort.com/journal/): All posts, updated regularly.
- [RSS feed](https://www.madefromeffort.com/journal/feed.xml): Full-text feed of every post.

Each Journal post is a real project story or a training/mindset lesson, in Scott Schratwieser's own voice, reviewed and approved by him before publishing — never syndicated or reposted content.
